verdict.rationale: Fedora's own page says Workstation lets you easily install the best desktop apps with the click of a button from Fedora's repositories, Flathub or elsewhere, and easily install and manage software. A hands-on community report contradicts this: the user had to run a page of commands to get Discord or Spotify working, and installed GUI apps did not appear in the start menu. missing for 10: the built-in app store is never named or described in detail, there is no independent confirmation that popular proprietary apps install in one click, and nothing shows the reported launcher and command-line problems were fixed.
